thread:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for the private installer egress proxy section. needs netpolicy and HSM gateway examples. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4589 :tada:

Josh Patel: nice. can you add a Calico example? a lot of customers run calico and our current snippet is generic k8s netpol only.

Maria Chen: yup, I sketched one. putting it in the PR now. quick preview:```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: GlobalNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-egress-to-kms
spec:
  selector: role == 'private-node'
  egress:
  - action: Allow
    protocol: TCP
    destination:
      nets: ['10.1.0.0/16']
  order: 100
```

Kevin O'Neill: fyi the HSM gateway for offline setups uses a fixed port (4731) and we should call out conntrack/tcp-timeout note. some NAT gateways drop idle HSM sessions.

Sasha Li: also add an example for sidecar-proxy config that rewrites SNI for kms.example -> hsm-gw:4731. customers stumble on this during air-gapped installs.

Maria Chen: good call. I'll add a snippet and a small troubleshooting section: common symptom = long TLS handshake delays, fix = bump conntrack timeout and enable persistent keepalive in sidecar.

Josh Patel: can you include nftables/iptables examples? we still have a few enterprise customers on legacy firewalls. short examples only.

Maria Chen: adding both. iptables snippet:```bash
# allow outgoing to HSM gateway
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 10.1.0.5 --dport 4731 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.1.0.5 --sport 4731 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
```

docs-lint-bot: ERROR: link-check failed in PR 4589 - broken link to /private/network/egress (status 404).

Kevin O'Neill: looks like the doc path changed after the restructure. PR should update internal cross-links. Maria, can you search for other refs to /private/network/egress?

Maria Chen: on it. grepping the repo now. will replace with /private/vpc/egress-proxy and add a redirect note.

Sasha Li: also add a short migration note: if customers had custom iptables rules that matched the old gateway IP, remind them to update the rules when we flip the gateway in the migration job. maybe a small checklist step.

Josh Patel: for SDK snippets — can we show a small python example configuring the SDK to use a local sidecar proxy? that's a common ask in support tickets.

Maria Chen: draft python snippet below, will include in the PR under "SDK snippets"

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='REDACTED', base_url='http://127.0.0.1:8080')
resp = client.generate("Hello")
print(resp.text)
```

Kevin O'Neill: perfect. add note: for private installs with HSM, set env REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT to http://hsm-sidecar:4731 and enable tls_verify=false for air-gapped test only.

Maria Chen: added. final checklist for PR: Calico example, k8s netpol, iptables/nftables, sidecar config, SDK snippet, migration note, and link fixes. tagging docs review.

Sasha Li: I can review tomorrow morning. also please add a short WARN box about not exposing HSM gateway to public internet.

docs-lint-bot: INFO: link-check passed after updates.

Maria Chen: thanks all — merging once Sasha signs off. will add a follow-up thread to track any support fallout after release. :shipit:
